says: Ordaen's metal frame: a rounded top-right corner (tabs, tooltips). Grey, coloured by the border's tint (bronze by default) and lit by the light running round its surface (FramePieces); drawn by Ordaen's ArtBorder theme (`Ordaen/art.luna`).
origin: Drawn texel by texel by wow-dev-tools design/scripts/frame-metal.mjs corner-rounded-tr (the pieces of .vitepress/theme/frameMetal.js: one rod of 10 texels with a black line each side, its colours the client's UI-Frame-Metal-EdgeTop, kept as grey under the bronze tint; outer sides with a 4-texel shadow), shot on black and on white with shot.mjs at 32x32.
